title: Infineon and Skeleton Partner on AI Power: What Roles Do SiC and GaN Play?
excerpt: An explanation of the AI data center power partnership that Infineon and Skeleton announced on September 2, 2026. We cover the roles of SiC-based solid-state transformers and peak shaving with GaN and supercapacitors, the development plan and the limits of published information, and what to watch next.
